retrievalProfile.description: A warm, high-key portrait featuring a sun-drenched subject paired with organic, hand-drawn typography and delicate botanical illustrations.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-key portrait of a woman lying down, bathed in warm, golden light that creates a soft, overexposed glow. The composition is framed by delicate, hand-drawn floral and leaf illustrations in the upper corners, with organic, textured lettering centered in the upper third.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's face as the primary focal point in the lower two-thirds
Hand-drawn typography anchored in the upper white space
Botanical illustrations framing the top corners to balance the composition
Warm golden light unifying the subject and the background
coreInvariants: High-key, overexposed lighting with a warm yellow/gold tint
Organic, hand-drawn quality to the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is positioned diagonally across the lower half, filling approximately 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the primary hand-drawn text serve as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the subject's face upward to the central text, then outward to the floral corner accents.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant bright, overexposed negative space in the upper third provides a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm white and golden yellow (background and lighting)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Earth-toned brown (primary text and leaf outlines)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft coral pink (floral accents and secondary text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) with low to moderate saturation, creating a washed-out, ethereal look.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid deep blacks or high-contrast cool tones

letterConstructionRules: Primary text features irregular, hand-drawn strokes with visible ink-like texture
Secondary text uses thin, monolinear geometric capitals
Varying baseline for the script to enhance the casual, organic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' in the script has a wide, sweeping curve
The 't' has a high, slightly tilted crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, textured script and clean, geometric sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Stylized sun/flower icons with radiating petals

preserve: Hand-drawn feel of the main title
avoid: Standard, clean digital fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the organic, hand-drawn texture of the primary text
Provides the geometric, airy feel for the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, overexposed portrait of a woman lying down, with warm golden lighting and a soft-focus background. Include line-art botanical illustrations in the top corners (leaves on the left, stylized flowers on the right).
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in a hand-drawn, textured script in earth-brown. Below it, add the subtitle in a thin, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif in coral pink.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting sufficiently warm and overexposed?
Does the script text have a visible hand-drawn texture?
Are the botanical elements positioned in the upper corners?
Is the subtitle color a soft coral pink?

mustRedesign: Avoid using generic brush fonts; ensure the script feels custom and irregular
Do not use high-contrast shadows on the face

mustAchieve: Organic, tactile feel in the graphics

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the bright background
Ensure the floral icons do not distract from the subject's face
Verify the warm color temperature is consistent across the image
Confirm the hand-drawn text has irregular baselines
recipe.reuseFormula: Warm High-Key Portrait + Organic Script + Geometric Subtitle + Corner Botanicals
